notice: Nepal Gazette vol. 72 no. 65, part 5 (Chaitra 2, 2079): the Ministry of Home Affairs' notice of the public, festival and substitute holidays of VS 2080

holidays.ne: राई, लिम्बू, याक्खा, सुनुवारलगायतका किराँत समुदायको उभौली पर्व - चण्डी पूर्णिमा (वैशाख पूर्णिमा)
holidays.en: Ubhauli of the Kirat community, the Rai, Limbu, Yakkha, Sunuwar and others: Chandi Purnima (the full moon of Baisakh)
The Dashain holiday (from Phulpati to the 12th)

holidays.ne: तिहार बिदा (कात्तिक २६ गते आइतबारदेखि कार्तिक ३० गते बिहीबारसम्म): लक्ष्मी पूजा; म्हपूजा, नेपाल संवत् प्रारम्भ, गोवर्द्धन पूजा; भाइ टीका/किजा पूजा
holidays.en: The Tihar holiday (Kartik 26 to 30): Lakshmi Puja; Mha Puja, the beginning of Nepal Sambat and Govardhan Puja; Bhai Tika and Kija Puja
Christmas Day, the festival of the Christians (25 December)

holidays.ne: किराँत समुदायको उधौली पर्व, योमरी पुन्हि - ज्यापू दिवस (धान्य पूर्णिमा)
holidays.en: Udhauli of the Kirat community, Yomari Punhi and Jyapu Day (Dhanya Purnima)

holidays.ne: हिमाली आदिवासी शेर्पाहरूले मनाउने ग्याल्पो ल्होसार
holidays.en: Gyalpo Lhosar, kept by the Himalayan indigenous Sherpas

holidays.ne: इस्लाम धर्मावलम्बीहरूको पर्व ईद (ईद उल फित्र) का दिन
holidays.en: On the day of Eid (Eid al-Fitr)

holidays.ne: इस्लाम धर्मावलम्बीहरूको पर्व बकर ईद (ईद उल अजहा) का दिन
holidays.en: On the day of Bakr Eid (Eid al-Adha)

holidays.ne: फागुपूर्णिमा - हिमाली र पहाडी लगायतका ५६ जिल्ला
holidays.en: Fagu Purnima, in the 56 districts, the mountain and hill districts among them

holidays.ne: फागुपूर्णिमा - झापा, मोरङ, सुनसरी, सप्तरी, सिराहा, उदयपुर, धनुषा, महोत्तरी, सर्लाही, रौतहट, बारा, पर्सा, नवलपरासी (बर्दघाट सुस्ता पूर्व), नवलपरासी (बर्दघाट सुस्ता पश्चिम), रुपन्देही, कपिलवस्तु, दाङ, बाँके, बर्दिया, कैलाली, कञ्चनपुर
holidays.en: Fagu Purnima, in the Terai districts: Jhapa, Morang, Sunsari, Saptari, Siraha, Udayapur, Dhanusha, Mahottari, Sarlahi, Rautahat, Bara, Parsa, Nawalparasi (Bardaghat Susta East), Nawalparasi (Bardaghat Susta West), Rupandehi, Kapilvastu, Dang, Banke, Bardiya, Kailali and Kanchanpur

holidays.ne: सिरुवा पावनी - झापा, मोरङ, सुनसरी, सिराहा, सप्तरी
holidays.en: Sirua Pavani, in the districts: Jhapa, Morang, Sunsari, Siraha and Saptari
Gai Jatra, in the Kathmandu valley
Indra Jatra, in the Kathmandu valley

holidays.ne: मत्स्येन्द्रनाथको भोटो देखाउने जात्रा (सो जात्रा हुने दिन)
holidays.en: The jatra showing Matsyendranath's vest (on the day of the jatra), in the Kathmandu valley
Ghode Jatra, in the Kathmandu valley
International Day of Persons with Disabilities (3 December)
On the day of Mohammad Jayanti

holidays.ne: जातीय भेदभाव तथा छुवाछुत उन्मूलन राष्ट्रिय दिवस
holidays.en: National Day for the Elimination of Caste Discrimination and Untouchability

DATES.notice: The Ministry of Home Affairs' notice on a public holiday of Chaitra 28, 2080

CANCELS.notice: Nepal Gazette vol. 73 no. 54, part 5 (Magh 29, 2080): the Ministry of Home Affairs' second notice, that VS 2080's Janayuddha Day holiday no longer stands
